retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style album cover featuring a central rounded-corner photograph framed by heavy black borders and ornate Western-inspired display typography.
triggerTerms: rounded photo frame on black background

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a central group portrait in a rounded-corner frame, set against a solid black field. The layout is topped by two tiers of decorative, Western-style slab serif lettering with a central ornamental divider.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-heavy top third balanced by image-heavy bottom two-thirds
Rounded rectangular photo window contrasting with sharp black outer frame
Ornate, multi-layered typography mirroring the formal attire of the subjects
Warm brick and skin tones popping against a dominant black and white graphic scheme
coreInvariants: Rounded corners on the internal image frame
Western-style slab serif with internal decorative detailing
Visible halftone dot pattern or film grain

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five men in suits occupies the center-bottom frame, scaled to fill the width of the rounded window.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white Western-style display text in the upper middle.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down: starting at the pink title, moving through the ornamental divider to the large white band name, and finally resting on the central group photo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black margins provide a thick frame around the entire composition.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dusty Pink (secondary typography) and Earthy Orange (brickwork)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and black background; muted saturation in the photographic element.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy horizontal serifs with bifurcated (fishtail) ends
High contrast between thick vertical strokes and thin horizontal connections
Arched or curved baselines for secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: S and C characters feature exaggerated spurs
O is perfectly circular with internal diamond detailing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Tiered hierarchy using color and scale to distinguish between title and artist name.
graphicDevices: Small boxed metadata label in bottom corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the Western slab serif aesthetic with decorative inlines
Provides the heavy slab weight and vintage feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of five men in 1960s mod suits posing in front of a vintage car and a brick wall, framed within a rounded-corner rectangle on a solid black background. Apply a vintage halftone print texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered Western slab serif text above the photo. The top line should be smaller and pink; the second line should be large and white. Place a small decorative scroll divider between them.

verificationChecks: Is the photo frame rounded at the corners?
Does the typography feature Western-style fishtail serifs?
Is the background a solid, deep black?
Is there a visible halftone or grain texture over the image?

adjustableVariables: Corner radius of the photo frame
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is centered and legible against the black background
Verify the rounded corners are consistent on all four sides of the image window
Check that the suits and hairstyles reflect a mid-1960s aesthetic
Confirm the presence of the decorative divider between text lines
recipe.reuseFormula: Central rounded-corner photo + Solid black field + Western slab serif display type + Halftone texture = 1960s Garage Rock Aesthetic
